translations.text: I confess to God the almighty Father and to all his saints and to these relics and to you, man of God, all my sins that I have thought and spoken and done,
that were against God and against my Christianity, against my faith, against my holy baptism and against my confession.
I confess envy, ill will, slander, swearing, sinful lusts, neglected hours of prayer, pride, wantonness,
sluggishness, laziness in God's service, lustful desires, fornications, murder and manslaughter, overeating and overdrinking.

I confess that I did not honour my father and my mother as I should have, that I did not honour my lord as I should have and did not love him as I should have, and that I did not love my neighbours as I should have,

and that I did not love my wife and my child and did not teach them as I should have, that I did not teach and did not love my disciples as I should have, and that I did not honour and did not teach my godchildren as I should have.
I confess that I did not honour holy Sunday and the holy Mass and did not celebrate them as I should have.
I confess that I did not pay my tithe as I should have, and that I stole and took stolen goods.

I confess that I did not visit the sick, did not comfort the sorrowful, and did not receive guests as I should have; that I did not reconcile people at odds whom I could have reconciled; and that I said more, both true and untrue [?], than I should have.
I confess that I believed what I should not have believed, and that I did not believe what I should have believed.

I confess wrongful looking, wrongful hearing, wrongful thoughts, wrongful words, wrongful deeds, wrongful sitting, wrongful standing, wrongful lying down, wrongful walking, wrongful touching, and wrongful kisses.
I confess that I broke my oath and swore false oaths on relics and by God's saints.
I confess disobedience, impatience and unfaithfulness, and that I held on to times of anger and strife.
I confess that I performed holy service and my prayer carelessly, that I received the holy sacrament unconfessed and unworthily, and that I did not keep it and honour it as I should have,
and that I did not honour the holy cross nor bear it as I should have, nor fulfil nor keep the commanded fasts and the cross processions as I should have.
I confess that I did not honour and did not love bishops and priests and men of God as I should have, and that I spoke and kept silent more than I should have.
I confess that I soiled and defiled myself with lusts, evil desires and evil thoughts more than I should have.
Of all this and of many other things that I committed against God's will and against what was right for me, whether I did it knowingly or unknowingly,
whether I did it by night or by day, sleeping or waking, willingly or unwillingly: whatever of all this I did against God's will,

I commit it into the protection of almighty God and into his mercy, and into a pure confession to almighty God and all his saints and to you, man of God, with faith, with repentance and with the will to atone for it,
And I humbly ask you to be willing to pray for me, so that the Lord, by his grace, may be willing to forgive me all my sins.
And the priest should then say: "May the Lord keep you from all evil.
May God the Father bless you, may God the Son keep you, may God the Holy Spirit enlighten you. May the Lord forgive you all your sins," and so on.
